responsibility: This header defines the target-global data structures and accessors GCC uses to track library helper functions implicitly called during expansion. It declares the libfunc_table indexes for non-optab helpers such as SjLj unwinding and synchronization, the libfunc_entry hash records that map optab and mode combinations to SYMBOL_REF libfunc RTXes, and the switchable-target target_libfuncs state object. It is the interface layer for target-dependent libcall bookkeeping used during RTL expansion and lowering.
